caption: luxor leaves egypt - an adventure map across the ancient world with the marble laws intact.
about: Luxor: Quest for the Afterlife (2008) turns the marble line into a journey: a story map carries the shooter from egypt across the ancient near east, each region remixing the track rules while the core chain-shooting stays untouched. It is the series' most narrative chapter and the last mainline pc entry before the spin-off era.
The pc build is off the current stores, carried by archive routes.
